text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going shopping with 
Loves Only You—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. You got a lottery ticket 
earlier, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan. You got a raffle ticket 
earlier, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why not give it a shot? Who knows, 
you might even win a hot spring trip!
choice_data_list: Then why doesn't Loves do it instead?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why? Didn't you receive that, 
Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking it could make good stream 
material.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why? Didn't you receive that, 
Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking it could make good stream 
material.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, true. Whichever one wins, it'll 
probably make for a good story...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ If we win anything, we'll split it 
between the two of us♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You eagerly turned the handle 
of the lottery machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Yay♡ Yaay~~♡♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! Hot springs! It's hot springs 
time♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan! Hot springs! Hot springs♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ I never expected to win the grand 
prize!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy the hot springs to the fullest 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why? Don't you like hot springs?
choice_data_list:
Because when I think about the community 
members...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ......Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really! That's what you were worried 
about~? You really are so serious~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, everyone will understand♪ 
We've known each other for so long, and 
you get it too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, everyone will understand♪ 
We've known each other for so long, and 
you get it too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I know! If you're that curious, let's 
just ask everyone right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
""I won a 'Hot Springs Trip Voucher' in 
the lottery~♡ Who should I go with, guys?" 
...and posted."
choice_data_list: Ah, if you ask like that...!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
""? Isn't it obvious?" "Ah, don't tell me 
someone's dragging their feet~?" 
"Honestly, don't give Loves such a hard 
time."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Well then, once again—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I can't wait for our hot springs trip ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I made a promise with Loves Only 
You to go on a hot spring trip together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay~! Look, look~ 1st prize♡
choice_data_list:
Wow, that looks incredibly delicious, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just what you'd expect from first 
prize, huh?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's split it up and eat!
choice_data_list:
Since we're doing this anyway, want to eat 
it on stream?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's great! Not a cooking stream, 
but an eating stream♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"With everyone preparing food for me too, 
it feels just like a party~♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, does everyone have their 
food ready~?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! For me, the usual salad 
chicken and broccoli!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm on a diet, so I'll just look! 
...Today's day four of my diet, you know. 
I'll break the three-day quitter curse 
once and for all...!"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"So, what about you, Loves-chan? What do 
you want to eat?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Me? As for meee——

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's the carrot hamburg steak I won from 
the lottery~~♪

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh!!" "You won that in the raffle?!" 
"You've really got the luck, huh~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It'll be hard to reply to comments while 
I'm eating, so sorry about that in 
advance♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright, everyone together—

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text: "THANKS FOR THE FOOO-OOOD!!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! It's this juicy just from 
heating it up!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, just pressing down with a fork 
makes the juices overflow♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hafu, hafu~~ Mmm~~~♡ So delicious~~♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
""............"" ""This is a bit..."" ""I 
wonder if there's anything in the 
fridge...""

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"...Gaaah! Today is officially a cheat 
day!!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...No good. I can't take this anymore...! 
I'm going to the convenience store...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew, thank you for the delicious meal♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to the absolute pandemonium 
in the comments section, she finished her 
meal happily.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that crazy amount of 
carrots! Their color is gorgeous, and they 
all look so fresh~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how should I cook this up, I 
wonder♪
choice_data_list: You're going to make it, Loves?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course it is! After all, cooking is 
my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today's stream is definitely going to be 
cooking♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Love Me♡ Love You♡ This was 
Loves Only You! See ya~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu, I got so excited that I ended up 
using it all up♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What should I dooo~!? I made way too 
much~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spread out before us was a full-course 
carrot dinner filling the entire table. 
There's no way just the two of us can 
finish this...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! I'm sure they'll help out! I'll go 
ask everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Feel free to eat as much as you'd like~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then I'll take the carrot salad!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Every dish is prepared with such exquisite 
care... Wasn't this an awful lot of work 
to make?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Not really. When I stream while doing it, 
it flies by in a flash♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while having fun with her 
friends, she was able to finish all the 
carrot dishes.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~, what a bit of a bummer!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Just one, huh...
choice_data_list: Why don't you take it home with you?
You take it home with you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let that happen. We promised to 
share, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah... alright!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat them on the way home♪ They're 
fresh, and if we wipe them off a bit, we 
can eat them right up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Here, I'll give you the bigger one.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
*munch munch*... Fufu, having raw carrots 
every now and then is nice too~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the sunset, the two of us 
munched on carrots together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh dear~...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes... but still!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, a bad draw makes for small 
talk that's far easier for others to 
relate to."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind. Today's stream will 
be—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's decided: the "Disappointing Moments 
Presentation"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attitude of turning even painful 
experiences into content for her stream 
was something truly worth emulating.
